question_text: Fill in the blanks with the words from the box. You may need to change the forms of
stimulus: some of the words. You may need to use one word more than once. 1×10= 10 by in destroy to with wash a from Trees are very useful (a) ----- man. They prevent the rich top soil (b) ----- being (c) ----- away (d) ----- rain water and floods. We can see trees being planted and damaged. Trees provide life to (e) ----- place (f) ----- their colourful flowers, beautiful leaves and fruits. They provide shelter (g) ----- birds and animals. They take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen. Man needs oxygen (h) ----- breathe. Actually, without trees our life (i) ----- the world is impossible. So, we should plant more trees and must refrain from (j) ----- trees and forest.
guide_solution: Filling in the blanks with clues: (a) to; (b) from; (c) washed; (d) with/by; (e) a; (f) with; (g) to; (h) to; (i) in; (j) destroying.
